about: A candidate playbook for ab-run (deck@variant) and runner/ab.py --data. Only the playbook object is read; the deck's data stays in its own file.

playbook.notes: Death Toll (Winter, Cynical Opportunist: deathtouch; mills three when she attacks; with delirium, at the end step exiles cards from the graveyard and puts a permanent among them onto the battlefield). Winter is flagged AI:RemoveDeck:All, so stock Forge never casts its own commander: 0 casts in the 12 audit games (seeds 27001-27012), where stock left 45% of its mana unspent and killed on turn 11.67. Rule 1 puts the rocks and ramp down, rule 2 casts Winter as soon as she is affordable, rule 3 the self-mill engine (Polluted Cistern, whose drain fires on every mill, Stitcher's Supplier, Nyx Weaver, also flagged never-cast, Crawling Sensation, Cemetery Tampering) while the library has 30 cards, rule 4 the other engines and walkers, rule 5 Deadbridge Chant (mills ten) only with 40 cards left, rule 6 Old Stickfingers with all the mana as X (at least 3), rule 7 Whip of Erebos's reanimation, rule 8 the mill spells with 25 cards left. Triggers: Cemetery Tampering, Crawling Sensation and Titania's mills while the library has 25 cards, Deathreap Ritual's draw with 10, Solemn's land; Winter's own end-step trigger is not asked as an optional trigger (Forge chooses the cards, and exiles the whole graveyard). The deck's answers (Putrefy, Convert to Slime, Binding the Old Gods, Culling Ritual, Deluge of Doom, Vile Mutilator, Ob Nixilis and Grist minus abilities, Noxious Gearhulk, Reanimate on an opponent's creature) are left to Forge for a second pass. Go-wide attack, highest life first. Version 2 (after the first validation games had been seen, so its figure is flattered): two of 40 validation games were lost to the seat milling itself, so rule 1 exiles Nyx Weaver for a card once the library is down to 30, Old Stickfingers is capped at X 5 and needs 30 cards, and holds keep Forge from casting Deadbridge Chant under 40 cards, the mill permanents and Old Stickfingers under 30 and the mill spells under 25; two trigger rules that never fired (Winter's end step and the upkeep mills are not asked as optional triggers) were dropped. Goldfish, validation seeds 27101-27140: stock 12.03, version 1 10.16 (+1.84 turns, 95% +1.25 to +2.44, 38 pairs), version 2 10.13 (+1.87, +1.30 to +2.44, 38 pairs); tuning seeds 27021-27040, version 2 against stock +2.35 (+1.66 to +3.04). The same two validation games still end Milled under version 2: the big mills there are not cast from hand (Deadbridge Chant put back onto the battlefield, most likely by Winter's delirium return, which Forge chooses), so a rule cannot stop them.
